name: White Fog
source:
This is the story of a lost soul, the strange world she finds herself in, and the memories she has forgotten, which can be recovered in this new world. Will she be able to remember her past, or will doing so only bring her deeper in to despair?

A short visual novel with seven endings.

This game is based on the lovely poem [url=http://www.itswritten.com/publicdomainpoetry/poetry.php?pdid=1942]"White Fog" by Sara Teasdale[/url].
translation:
这是一个迷失灵魂、她身处的奇异世界，以及她遗忘的记忆的故事。在这个新世界中，她可以找回那些记忆。她能记起过去吗？还是回忆只会把她带入更深的绝望？

一部拥有7个结局的短篇视觉小说。

本作以莎拉·蒂斯黛尔的诗歌[url=http://www.itswritten.com/publicdomainpoetry/poetry.php?pdid=1942]《白雾》[/url]为基础。
